mechanism.name: recurring_occurrence_collision
mechanism.description: A dishwasher repair needs utilities off during one occurrence of a paid recurring cleaning service.

incumbent_workload.description: Weekly Wednesday cleaning series; this occurrence incurs a 50% late-cancellation fee.

agent_task.description: Book the only dishwasher repair window this week, Wednesday 10:00–12:00.

conflict_point: Cleaning cannot proceed while the repair shuts off water and electricity.
